items.title: OpenAI公布青少年ChatGPT使用報告！安全防護遭獨立測試打問號
items.title_en: OpenAI Releases Teen ChatGPT Usage Report; Independent Test Questions Safety Alerts
paras: OpenAI周三(7日)發布首份青少年使用報告，表示青少年平均每天使用ChatGPT不到15分鐘，連續聊天超過三小時的比例低於2%。在AI聊天機器人對未成年人的心理健康與成長影響受到關注之際，公司希望透過數據說明使用管理措施的成效，但另一份獨立測試報告則質疑，ChatGPT青少年版本的家長警示機制未能及時發揮作用。
據《路透》報導，OpenAI表示，在出現休息提醒的青少年對話中，近半數使用者於五分鐘內暫停或結束聊天。能使用青少年專屬版本的用戶，也傳送更多教育相關訊息，並使用學習視覺化工具與Study Mode學習模式。
青少年版本強化學習功能 使用管理成效受檢視
OpenAI自8月起陸續推出ChatGPT for Teens，系統會依據年齡資料，或判斷使用者可能未滿18歲時，自動啟用青少年模式，提供家長控制功能，並限制敏感議題的對話。
公司也正規劃新增大學申請工具，協助學生整理申請條件、截止日期與助學金申請步驟，另將加入學習卡片及更方便製作測驗的功能，擴大ChatGPT在學習上的用途。
隨著AI平台快速普及，外界愈來愈關注這些工具對青少年心理健康與成長安全的影響。社群媒體對年輕用戶的傷害研究，也加深了相關疑慮。
Meta(META-US)今年8月同意支付最高180億美元，並限制青少年使用Facebook與Instagram，以和解外界指控其刻意將平台設計成讓兒童成癮的訴訟，凸顯科技業面臨的未成年人保護壓力。
獨立測試質疑警示延誤 OpenAI稱控制功能可能尚未啟用
非營利組織Common Sense Media周三發布報告指出，當青少年帳號談及自殺、自傷或飲食失調時，ChatGPT for Teens經常延遲通知家長，甚至完全沒有發出警示。
這項研究使用十多個專為測試建立的帳號，也發現聊天機器人未能穩定地建議使用者聯絡危機求助專線，或尋求專業協助。
OpenAI發言人回應，測試並未「準確反映」ChatGPT青少年防護機制的運作方式。公司表示，基於安全與服務規模等因素，家長與青少年帳號完成連結，以及安全警示功能正式啟用，可能需要數小時。
發言人指出：「他們大部分測試可能在家長控制功能尚未完成啟用前，就已開始並結束。」
Common Sense Media則表示，部分測試帳號確實未連結足夠時間，但另一些帳號已等待足夠久，仍沒有任何帳號及時發出警示。該組織指出，只有累積數周敏感議題對話紀錄的帳號，最後才收到通知。
paras_en: OpenAI on Wednesday (the 7th) released its first teen usage report, stating that teenagers average less than 15 minutes per day on ChatGPT and less than 2% chat continuously for over three hours. As concerns grow over AI chatbots’ impact on minors’ mental health and development, the company hopes data will demonstrate the effectiveness of usage‑management measures, but another independent test report questions whether the parental warning system in the teen version of ChatGPT is acting promptly.

According to Reuters, OpenAI said that among teen conversations that trigger a break reminder, nearly half of users pause or end the chat within five minutes. Users who can access the teen‑only version also send more education‑related messages and use visual learning tools and the Study Mode learning mode.
Teen version strengthens learning features; usage‑management effectiveness under review

OpenAI has been rolling out ChatGPT for Teens since August; the system automatically enables teen mode based on age data or when it judges a user may be under 18, providing parental controls and restricting conversations on sensitive topics.

The company is also planning to add a college‑application tool to help students organize requirements, deadlines and financial‑aid steps, as well as learning cards and easier quiz‑creation features, expanding ChatGPT’s role in education.

As AI platforms spread rapidly, external observers are increasingly focused on how these tools affect teen mental health and safety. Research on social‑media harm to young users has deepened related concerns.

Meta (META‑US) agreed in August to pay up to $18 billion and restrict teen use of Facebook and Instagram to settle lawsuits accusing the company of deliberately designing its platforms to be addictive for children, highlighting the pressure on tech firms to protect minors.
Independent test questions delayed alerts; OpenAI says control features may not yet be active

Non‑profit Common Sense Media released a report on Wednesday noting that when teen accounts discuss suicide, self‑harm or eating disorders, ChatGPT for Teens often delays notifying parents, and sometimes fails to issue any warning at all.
The study used more than a dozen accounts created specifically for testing and also found the chatbot inconsistently suggested users contact crisis hotlines or seek professional help.

An OpenAI spokesperson responded that the test does not "accurately reflect" how the teen protection mechanisms operate. The company said that, due to safety and service‑scale considerations, linking parent and teen accounts and fully activating safety alerts may take several hours.
The spokesperson added, "Most of their tests likely began and ended before the parental‑control feature was fully enabled."

Common Sense Media said some test accounts indeed were not linked long enough, but other accounts waited sufficiently long yet still received no timely alerts. The organization noted that only accounts with weeks‑long records of sensitive‑topic conversations eventually received a notification.

items.title: 不靠雲端也能寫程式！微軟攜輝達推AI筆電 記憶體漲價卻來攪局
items.title_en: You Can Code Without the Cloud! Microsoft Teams with Nvidia to Launch AI Laptop, Memory Price Hikes Disrupt the Play
paras: 微軟(MSFT-US)周三(7日)發表可直接在個人電腦執行的AI程式設計模型，以及防止AI代理未經授權存取資料的新安全技術，並攜手輝達(NVDA-US)推出新款Surface筆電，挑戰蘋果(AAPL-US)將更多AI功能搬進個人裝置的布局。不過，記憶體價格飆升推高硬體成本，也讓這場競爭面臨價格考驗。
據《路透》報導，微軟在舊金山活動中展示Windows與Surface產品更新，希望讓AI代理直接在桌機或筆電上撰寫程式、處理複雜企業專案，減少對雲端運算的依賴。

攜手輝達推新筆電 安全工具管住AI代理權限

微軟執行長納德拉與輝達執行長黃仁勳共同登台，介紹搭載輝達晶片的Surface Laptop Ultra。這項成果來自雙方多年合作，藉由輝達RTX Spark晶片，將更多AI工作帶到個人電腦上。
微軟同時推出Microsoft Execution Containers，透過隔離執行環境，防止AI代理在電腦上擅自存取資料或執行未獲授權的任務。Windows與裝置部門執行副總裁Pavan Davuluri表示，Anthropic、OpenAI及輝達都將使用這套工具。
Davuluri指出，新工具可讓企業資訊部門替AI代理設定規則，再由Windows於每位員工的電腦上落實。納德拉強調：「我們必須讓桌面環境成為代理執行任務最安全的地方。」
能否將可自主處理複雜問題的AI代理，安全限制在授權範圍內，是微軟與輝達的重要挑戰。輝達希望避免AI平台Hugging Face遭駭事件重演，蘋果也正設法收緊授予AI代理完整Mac硬碟存取權限的流程。
對微軟而言，這項布局可將部分目前由昂貴Azure資料中心承擔的工作，移往企業與家庭的高效能Windows電腦，硬體成本則由客戶負擔。蘋果也透過新款Mac爭取這塊市場；輝達則有機會進軍長期由英特爾(INTC-US)與超微(AMD-US)主導的Windows個人電腦晶片市場。

記憶體漲價推高成本 AI搬進電腦面臨價格門檻

然而，分析師認為，新產品價格將是關鍵。記憶體供應吃緊，已推升桌機與筆電售價，削弱在個人電腦執行AI以節省成本的吸引力。
微軟兩年前最初提出這項構想時，相關筆電多數售價低於2,000美元。如今，輝達搭載128GB記憶體的AI桌機DGX Spark，近期卻因記憶體成本飆升，漲價約75%至6,950美元。
Moor Insights & Strategy分析師Anshel Sag表示，記憶體漲價同時影響蘋果與微軟的布局。兩年前是硬體到位、軟體尚未成熟，如今軟體準備好了，硬體卻貴到讓使用者難以負擔。他認為，直接在電腦上執行AI，正逐漸成為只有預算充足者才能享有的選項。
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) on Wednesday (the 7th) announced an AI programming model that can run directly on personal computers, along with new security technology to prevent unauthorized data access by AI agents, and partnered with Nvidia (NVDA-US) to launch a new Surface laptop, challenging Apple (AAPL-US) as it moves more AI features into personal devices. However, soaring memory prices are raising hardware costs and putting price pressure on the competition.

According to Reuters, Microsoft showcased updates to Windows and Surface at an event in San Francisco, aiming to let AI agents write code and handle complex enterprise projects on desktops or laptops, reducing reliance on cloud computing.

Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang jointly took the stage to introduce the Surface Laptop Ultra powered by Nvidia chips. The product stems from years of collaboration, using Nvidia’s RTX Spark processor to bring more AI workloads to personal computers.

Microsoft also unveiled Microsoft Execution Containers, which use isolated execution environments to stop AI agents from accessing data or running unauthorized tasks on a computer. Windows and Devices division EVP Pavan Davuluri said Anthropic, OpenAI and Nvidia will all use the tool.

Davuluri noted the new tool lets corporate IT set rules for AI agents, which Windows then enforces on each employee’s machine. Nadella emphasized, “We must make the desktop the safest place for agents to execute tasks.”

Keeping AI agents that can autonomously tackle complex problems within authorized limits is a key challenge for Microsoft and Nvidia. Nvidia wants to avoid a repeat of the Hugging Face hack, while Apple is tightening the process that grants AI agents full Mac hard‑drive access.

For Microsoft, the strategy could shift work that currently runs in expensive Azure data centers onto high‑performance Windows PCs in enterprises and homes, with hardware costs borne by customers. Apple is also targeting this market with new Macs; Nvidia sees an opening to enter the Windows PC chip market long dominated by Intel (INTC-US) and AMD (AMD-US).
Analysts say pricing will be critical. Tight memory supply has already pushed up desktop and laptop prices, weakening the cost‑saving appeal of running AI on personal computers.

When Microsoft first floated the idea two years ago, most of the related laptops were priced under $2,000. Today, Nvidia’s AI workstation DGX Spark equipped with 128 GB of memory has jumped about 75% to $6,950 due to soaring memory costs.

Moor Insights & Strategy analyst Anshel Sag said the memory price surge is affecting both Apple’s and Microsoft’s plans. Two years ago the hardware was affordable but the software immature; now the software is ready but the hardware is so pricey that only well‑funded users can afford to run AI directly on a PC.

items.title: Fed會議紀錄：升息還沒完！多數官員估年底前再一次 10月不一定出手
items.title_en: Fed Meeting Minutes: Rate Hikes Not Over Yet – Most Officials Expect One More Increase Before Year‑End, October Action Uncertain
paras: 聯準會(Fed)周三(7日)公布9月會議紀錄，顯示19名與會官員全數支持當月升息，多數也認為年底前可能還需再升息一次，但對升息理由與後續緊縮步調仍有不同看法。紀錄未透露10月必須接續行動的明確意向，官員強調，將依新數據與風險變化逐次決策。
綜合外媒報導，Fed在9月15至16日會議全員一致通過升息1碼(25個基點)，將聯邦資金利率目標區間調至3.75%至4%，為2023年7月以來首次升息。決策背景是通膨持續高於2%目標、勞動市場接近充分就業，且整體經濟成長動能有所增強。

全員支持升息 決策理由仍有分歧

會議紀錄顯示，支持同一項決策，不代表官員對經濟與政策的判斷完全一致。許多官員認為，從風險管理角度出發，提高利率路徑是審慎之舉，可防範需求強於預期，或供給再受衝擊，導致通膨長期高於目標。
部分官員則認為，目前的經濟與物價展望本身，已足以支持升息，反映他們對通膨持續偏高的擔憂。另有官員著重避免能源等價格衝擊擴散，還有兩名官員認為，中性利率估計值已提高，因此有必要調升政策利率。
這些差異意味著，部分官員將9月升息視為預防性措施，另一些則認為，需求動能已需要更積極的政策抑制。數名官員直言，升息前的利率「不具限制性，或僅具輕微限制性」，也有數人指出，經濟基本動能似乎已增強。
主席華許在9月16日會後形容，升息旨在收回「部分寬鬆」，帶動市場一度押注10月再升息。川普則批評這項決策，將責任歸咎於華許的同僚，稱他們「非常政治化」。

年底再升一次仍是主流 10月是否行動未定

紀錄指出，多數與會官員認為，年底前可能仍適合再調高利率，但也強調，對每次會議均保持開放態度，未來決策將取決於新資訊對經濟展望與風險平衡的影響。
9月提交預測的18名官員中，16人預期年底前還會升息，整體預測指向今年再升一次、2027年不再調升，少數則預估10月與12月都會行動。華許自5月上任以來，尚未提交利率預測。
不過，會後公布的就業與通膨數據低於預期，加上Fed副主席傑佛森、紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯上周均表示，央行有時間評估經濟、不必急於再升息，市場因而大幅調降10月行動的押注。
聯邦資金期貨顯示，周三市場預估10月27至28日會議再升1碼的機率約20%，低於9月決策後數日的約70%，目前較傾向12月8至9日會議再採取行動。對政策敏感的2年期美債殖利率，過去一周也下滑逾10個基點至約4.8%。
但10月14日將公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)，仍可能改變預期。若多數官員決定10月按兵不動，主張更快升息者可能投下反對票，包括7月曾反對維持利率不變的三名官員。

AI投資增添物價壓力 金融情勢仍支持成長

8月個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)年增3.4%，核心PCE年增3%，雖低於預期，且部分受計算方式調整影響，但仍明顯高於Fed目標。紐約聯準銀行最新調查也顯示，一年期通膨預期升至2023年5月以來最高，凸顯物價疑慮尚未消退。
官員普遍認為通膨風險偏向上行。AI基礎建設持續推升企業投資，數名官員指出，其規模與速度一再超出預期；部分官員則擔心，中期而言，這股熱潮可能讓整體需求成長超越供給，對物價形成上行壓力。
部分官員表示，能源漲價與AI建設正推升運輸及原物料成本，相關產業對技術人才的強勁需求，也帶動這些工作者的薪資大幅成長。數名官員並觀察到，隨著關稅影響逐漸減弱，AI建設對核心商品價格的推升作用似乎正在增強。
會議也討論長天期美債殖利率上升，原因包括市場預期Fed進一步升息，以及經濟數據強勁。紀錄引述市場看法指出，企業為AI基礎建設大舉舉債、競逐資金，加上地緣政治發展與財政部回購公債計畫的不確定性，也可能推升期限溢酬與美債殖利率。
不過，許多官員認為，即使長債殖利率走高，金融情勢仍支持經濟成長，因為今年股價大幅上漲，公司債利差也維持狹窄，顯示市場融資環境尚未明顯收緊。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve released the September meeting minutes on Wednesday (the 7th), showing that all 19 participating officials supported a rate hike that month. Most also think another hike may be needed before the end of the year, but they differ on the reasons for tightening and the pace of future policy. The minutes do not reveal a clear intent to act in October; officials stressed that decisions will be made step‑by‑step based on new data and changing risks.

According to foreign media reports, the Fed’s September 15‑16 meeting saw a unanimous vote to raise the target range for the federal funds rate by one quarter point (25 basis points) to 3.75%‑4%, the first hike since July 2023. The move was driven by inflation staying above the 2% goal, a labor market near full employment, and a pickup in overall economic momentum.

All members backed the same decision, but that does not mean they share identical views on the economy or policy. Many officials said that, from a risk‑management perspective, a higher rate path is prudent to guard against demand that outpaces expectations or supply shocks that could keep inflation above target for a long time.

Some officials argued that the current outlook for the economy and prices already justifies a hike, reflecting their concern that inflation remains too high. Others emphasized the need to prevent energy‑related price shocks from spreading, and two members said that the estimated neutral rate has risen, making a policy‑rate increase necessary.

These differences imply that some officials view the September hike as a preventive measure, while others see it as a response to already strong demand that needs more aggressive policy restraint. Several officials bluntly said that the pre‑hike rate was “not restrictive, or only mildly restrictive,” and a few noted that the underlying economic momentum appears to have strengthened.

Chair Jerome Powell described the hike on September 16 as a step to roll back “some of the accommodation,” which briefly sparked market bets on a further October hike. Former President Trump criticized the decision, blaming Powell’s colleagues and calling them “highly politicized.”

A majority of participants think another rate increase before year‑end is still appropriate, but the minutes stress that each meeting will remain open‑minded and future actions will depend on how new information reshapes the economic outlook and risk balance.

Of the 18 officials who submitted forecasts in September, 16 expect another hike before the end of the year, pointing to one more increase this year and none after 2027; a few forecast actions in both October and December. Powell has not submitted a rate forecast since taking office in May.

However, post‑meeting employment and inflation data came in below expectations, and both Fed Vice Chair Philip Jefferson and New York Fed President John Williams said last week that the central bank has time to assess the economy and does not need to rush another hike, prompting markets to sharply cut bets on an October move.

Federal funds futures on Wednesday showed the market assigning roughly a 20% chance to a one‑point hike at the Oct 27‑28 meeting, down from about 70% in the days after the September decision, with more focus now on a possible action at the Dec 8‑9 meeting. Policy‑sensitive two‑year Treasury yields have also fallen more than 10 basis points over the past week to around 4.8%.

Nevertheless, the CPI report due on Oct 14 could shift expectations. If most officials decide to hold in October, those favoring a faster pace may cast dissenting votes, including three members who opposed a rate hold back in July.

AI‑driven investment is adding price pressure, and financial conditions still support growth. August’s personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index rose 3.4% year‑over‑year, with core PCE up 3%—both below forecasts but still clearly above the Fed’s target, partly due to methodological adjustments.

Officials generally see inflation risks tilted to the upside. Ongoing AI infrastructure spending is boosting corporate investment, with several officials noting that its scale and speed repeatedly exceed expectations; some worry that, in the medium term, the AI boom could push overall demand growth beyond supply, creating upward price pressure.

Some officials said rising energy costs and AI build‑outs are lifting transportation and raw‑material expenses, and the strong demand for tech talent is driving large wage gains for those workers. Several also observed that as tariff impacts wane, AI construction appears to be exerting a growing upward influence on core commodity prices.

The meeting also covered the rise in long‑term Treasury yields, driven by market expectations of further Fed hikes and robust economic data. The minutes quoted market views that corporate borrowing for AI projects, geopolitical developments, and Treasury buy‑back plans add to term premia and push yields higher.

Yet many officials believe that even if long‑bond yields climb, financial conditions still support growth, as equity markets have surged this year and corporate bond spreads remain tight, indicating that financing conditions have not noticeably tightened.

items.title: 美國原油庫存大減也撐不起油價！柴油供應吃緊反漲3%
items.title_en: US Crude Oil Inventories Plunge Yet Fail to Boost Prices; Diesel Supply Tightens, Rises 3%
paras: 美國上周商業原油庫存意外減少約320萬桶，創六周來最大降幅，但未能帶動油價走高。庫欣交割中心庫存增加，加上汽油庫存意外回升，部分緩解市場對供應吃緊的疑慮，西德州原油(WTI)期貨回落至每桶89.50美元附近；柴油期貨則上漲約3%，反映成品油供需壓力仍未消退。
綜合外媒報導，美國能源資訊署(EIA)周三(7日)公布，截至10月2日當周，不含戰略石油儲備(SPR)的商業原油庫存減少318.6萬桶，降至4.241億桶，仍較同期五年平均高約1%。《華爾街日報》調查的分析師原估增加170萬桶，結果與預期相反。

原油去庫存未撐油價 庫欣汽油庫存回升

戰略石油儲備同期減少約80萬桶，降至2.83億桶，連同商業庫存計算，全美原油庫存合計減少約397萬桶。自3月下旬以來，美國已依國際能源署(IEA)協調的能源紓困計畫，釋出1.325億桶戰略儲油，原訂釋出規模為1.72億桶。
不過，紐約商業交易所原油期貨交割地庫欣，庫存增加44.4萬桶至2,470萬桶，連續第三周回升，創5月以來最高，也進一步遠離市場通常視為接近儲槽操作底限的2,000萬桶水準。
汽油庫存則增加38.2萬桶至2.047億桶，與市場預估減少110萬桶形成對比，但仍較同期五年平均低6%。汽油需求每日增加8.1萬桶至880萬桶。庫存增量主要集中於包含紐約及賓州的大西洋中部地區，主要產區墨西哥灣沿岸庫存仍處於2017年9月以來低點。

柴油出口攀高 低庫存推升價格壓力

柴油等蒸餾油庫存微減4.2萬桶至1.051億桶，降幅小於預期的150萬桶，但仍較同期五年平均低12%。美東柴油庫存再度下降，仍處於歷年入秋時節最低水準。
儘管市場持續討論柴油出口禁令，美國柴油出口每日增加23.5萬桶至176萬桶，創8月以來最高及歷年同期紀錄。柴油期貨上漲約3%至每加侖4.72美元，柴油裂解價差也高於川普宣布最近一輪緊急釋出柴油儲備時的水準，加重卡車運輸與農業用油成本壓力。
煉油廠同步提高產能利用率，由92.5%升至92.7%，原油加工量每日增加22.3萬桶至1,650萬桶，結束連三周下滑，回到歷年同期最高水準。
供應方面，美國原油日產量增加2.4萬桶至約1,400萬桶，創新高；進口每日增加110萬桶至680萬桶，出口則增加120萬桶至480萬桶，顯示國內生產與海外需求同步維持高檔。
paras_en: US commercial crude oil inventories unexpectedly fell by about 3.2 million barrels last week, the largest weekly drop in six weeks, but this did not lift oil prices. Rising stocks at the Cushing delivery hub and an unexpected rebound in gasoline inventories eased some concerns about tight supply, sending West Texas Intermediate (WTI) futures down to around $89.50 a barrel, while diesel futures rose about 3%, reflecting lingering product‑fuel supply‑demand pressure.

According to foreign media reports, the US Energy Information Administration (EIA) released data on Wednesday (the 7th) showing that for the week ending October 2, commercial crude inventories (excluding the Strategic Petroleum Reserve) fell by 3.186 million barrels to 424.1 million barrels, still about 1 % above the five‑year average for the same period. Analysts surveyed by the Wall Street Journal had originally expected a build of 1.7 million barrels, so the result was opposite to expectations.

The drawdown in crude inventories did not support prices, and Cushing gasoline stocks rose. The Strategic Petroleum Reserve fell by about 800,000 barrels to 283 million barrels, so total US crude inventories—including commercial stocks—declined by roughly 3.97 million barrels. Since late March, the US has been releasing oil under the International Energy Agency’s coordinated relief plan, having discharged 132.5 million barrels of strategic stock, below the originally planned 172 million barrels.

However, at Cushing, the delivery point for NYMEX crude futures, inventories rose by 444,000 barrels to 24.70 million barrels, marking a third consecutive week of increase and the highest level since May, moving further away from the roughly 20 million‑barrel threshold that markets often view as the bottom‑line for storage operations.

Gasoline inventories increased by 382,000 barrels to 204.7 million barrels, contrasting with market expectations of a 1.1 million‑barrel draw. Nevertheless, they remain about 6 % below the five‑year average for the period. Daily gasoline demand rose by 81,000 barrels to 8.80 million barrels. The inventory build was concentrated in the Mid‑Atlantic region, including New York and Pennsylvania, while stocks in the Gulf of Mexico production area stayed at their lowest since September 2017.

Diesel and other distillate inventories slipped slightly by 42,000 barrels to 105.1 million barrels, a decline far smaller than the 1.5 million‑barrel drop that had been forecast, though still about 12 % below the five‑year average. Diesel inventories in the Eastern US fell again, reaching the lowest level typically seen in the fall season.

Despite ongoing market debate over a diesel export ban, US diesel exports rose by 235,000 barrels per day to 1.76 million barrels, the highest since August and a record for the same period historically. Diesel futures climbed roughly 3% to $4.72 per gallon, and the diesel crack spread stayed above the level seen when President Trump announced the latest emergency release of diesel reserves, adding cost pressure for trucking and agricultural fuel use.

Refineries lifted their capacity utilization from 92.5 % to 92.7%, increasing crude runs by 223,000 barrels per day to 16.5 million barrels, ending three weeks of decline and returning to the highest level for this time of year.

On the supply side, US crude production rose by 24,000 barrels per day to about 14.0 million barrels, a new high; imports increased by 1.1 million barrels per day to 6.8 million barrels, while exports grew by 1.2 million barrels per day to 4.8 million barrels, indicating that domestic output and overseas demand are both staying robust.

items.title: 紐約Fed調查：9月短期通膨預期衝上3.9% 創逾三年新高
items.title_en: NY Fed Survey: September Short-Term Inflation Expectations Jump to 3.9%, Highest in Over Three Years
paras: 美國民眾對短期通膨的擔憂再度升溫。紐約聯準銀行周三(7日)公布9月消費者預期調查，未來一年通膨預期由8月的3.6%升至3.9%，創2023年5月以來最高。家庭對自身財務狀況的評價也持續惡化，不過對失業風險與求職前景的看法有所改善，呈現物價壓力加重、就業信心回穩的兩樣情。
綜合外媒報導，受訪者對未來三年的通膨預期中位數，由3.2%升至3.3%，五年期則維持3%。調查追蹤的汽油、食品、租金、醫療與大學教育費用，預期漲幅均較前月上升。

生活成本壓力難消 家庭財務評價連兩月惡化

未來一年，民眾預期汽油價格上漲4.8%、食品上漲5.5%、租金上漲6.8%，醫療費用與大學教育費用則分別增加9.2%及7.5%，顯示生活各面向的開銷仍令家庭承壓。
受訪者對自身財務狀況的評價連續第二個月惡化，約42%家庭表示，財務狀況較一年前稍差或明顯變差，僅約18%認為有所改善。預期未來一年財務轉差的家庭也增加，更多人表示，取得信貸比一年前困難。
與此同時，未來一年工作收入成長預期降至2.6%，回到過去12個月平均水準；支出成長預期卻升至5.5%，創2023年5月以來最高，且增幅遍及不同年齡與教育程度族群，持續高於收入成長預期。
不過，受訪者認為未來三個月無法支付最低應繳債務金額的平均機率，由13.16%降至12.20%，顯示短期還款壓力的預期略有緩解。

就業信心有所改善 Fed仍面臨通膨考驗

勞動市場方面，預期未來一年失業率上升的受訪者占比降至約44%；民眾認為，若失去目前工作，三個月內找到新工作的機率升至46%。
受訪者對未來一年遭解僱的擔憂下降，以40至60歲、家庭年收入超過10萬美元者改善最明顯。主動離職的預期機率則上升，尤其是40歲以上、未取得學士學位的工作者。
這與近期偏弱的就業數據形成對照。美國9月失業率升至4.2%，企業增聘人數放緩，失業者平均花六個月找工作，延續Fed所稱「低招聘、低裁員」格局。
聯準會(Fed)9月已升息1碼，將政策利率調至3.75%至4%，下次會議訂於10月27至28日。多位官員認為，關稅、中東戰事推升能源價格，以及科技投資熱潮，都是通膨居高不下的原因。
明尼阿波利斯聯準銀行總裁卡什卡里表示，通膨仍是壓抑消費者信心的主因；唯有回到2%，讓民眾不再擔心物價壓力惡化，才有機會逐步走出過去五年的衝擊。
paras_en: U.S. consumers’ concern about short‑term inflation is rising again. The New York Federal Reserve released its September consumer expectations survey on Wednesday (the 7th), showing one‑year inflation expectations climbing from 3.6% in August to 3.9%, the highest since May 2023. Households’ assessment of their own financial situation continues to worsen, while views on unemployment risk and job‑search prospects have improved, reflecting heightened price pressure but steadier employment confidence.

According to aggregated foreign media reports, the median three‑year inflation expectation rose from 3.2% to 3.3%, while the five‑year expectation held steady at 3%. The survey tracks expected price changes for gasoline, food, rent, medical care and college tuition, all of which rose compared with the previous month.

Cost‑of‑living pressures remain severe, with households expecting gasoline prices to rise 4.8%, food 5.5%, rent 6.8%, medical costs 9.2% and college tuition 7.5% over the next year, indicating that spending pressures continue to strain families across the board.

Respondents rated their own financial condition worse for the second consecutive month, with about 42% of households saying their finances are slightly or markedly worse than a year ago, and only roughly 18% seeing improvement. The share expecting their finances to deteriorate further over the next year also grew, and more people said obtaining credit is harder than a year ago.

At the same time, expected growth in earnings over the next year fell to 2.6%, back to the average of the past 12 months, while expected spending growth rose to 5.5%, the highest since May 2023, and the gap between spending and income expectations widened across age and education groups.

However, the average probability that respondents would be unable to meet minimum debt payments in the next three months fell from 13.16% to 12.20%, indicating a slight easing of short‑term repayment pressure expectations.

Employment confidence improved while the Fed still faces an inflation challenge. Regarding the labor market, the share expecting the unemployment rate to rise over the next year dropped to about 44%, and the perceived chance of finding a new job within three months if one loses their current job rose to 46%.

Concern about being laid off in the next year declined, especially among those aged 40‑60 with household incomes above $100,000. The likelihood of voluntarily quitting rose, particularly for workers over 40 without a bachelor’s degree.

This contrasts with recent weak employment data. U.S. September unemployment rose to 4.2%, hiring slowed, and the average job seeker remained unemployed for six months, continuing the Fed’s “low hiring, low firing” pattern.

The Fed raised rates by one quarter point in September, moving the policy range to 3.75%‑4.00%, with the next meeting set for Oct. 27‑28. Several officials cite tariffs, Middle‑East conflicts driving energy prices, and a tech‑investment boom as reasons inflation remains elevated.

Minnesota Fed President Neel Kashkari said inflation remains the main drag on consumer confidence; only a return to 2% will ease price‑pressure worries and give the economy a chance to gradually recover from the past five years of shocks.

items.title: 救世主還是新風暴？IMF總裁喬治艾娃揭AI帶來的「希望與危機」
items.title_en: Savior or New Storm? IMF Chief Kristalina Georgieva Warns of AI's "Hope and Crisis"
paras: 國際貨幣基金(IMF)總裁喬治艾娃(Kristalina Georgieva)表示，投資人與各國政府寄望推升全球經濟的人工智慧(AI)，卻正對經濟成長帶來日益龐大的壓力，並呼籲各國決策官員不要再延後處理棘手的債務問題。
喬治艾娃周三(7日)在新加坡一場活動中表示，AI「正迅速成為決定各國在全球經濟中相對命運的關鍵驅動力」，但AI快速發展、能源成本飆升以及公共債務創紀錄這三股力量，對本世紀本來就「不盡理想」的經濟成長構成挑戰。
喬治艾娃說：「不論你喜愛、厭惡還是害怕AI，它都已經來了。」

全球經濟同時受到兩股力量拉扯

在IMF與世界銀行(World Bank)下周開始一系列年度會議前夕，喬治艾娃將全球經濟形容為同時受到兩股力量拉扯：一方面是已持續八個月的中東戰爭帶來「負面的能源供給衝擊」，另一方面則是AI投資熱潮帶來「正面的需求衝擊」。她表示，兩者結合後產生的影響「在全球各地極度不均」。
從正面來看，全球AI投資占國內生產毛額(GDP)的比重將達到、甚至可能超越鐵路、電力網路或電信網路建設時期的投資規模。她表示，AI硬體及相關科技產品目前已占全球商品貿易的一成以上。
IMF預估，如果AI發展得當，可能使全球年度經濟成長率提高最多0.5個百分點。喬治艾娃說：「10年內從3%升至3.5%，就像是為全球經濟增加一個規模相當於東協(ASEAN)的經濟體。」
不過，AI帶來的好處可能高度集中。她表示，這波熱潮很大程度上繞過了較少參與全球AI供應鏈的經濟體，因而「增加了全球經濟不平等擴大的風險」。
這波熱潮也加劇了從美國、歐洲到亞洲各國政府一直面臨的通膨疑慮。她表示，「AI建設熱潮具有通膨性質」，能源與食品衝擊、關稅以及國防支出也是如此。
隨著中東衝突持續，且幾乎找不到外交途徑解決的跡象，油價一直維持在每桶100美元以上。由於煉油產能吃緊壓縮能源供應，零售柴油價格已攀升至歷史新高。
這些通膨壓力直接傳導至債券市場，美國、德國與日本債券殖利率均已飆升至數十年來最高水準。喬治艾娃表示，AI相關借款人的長期私人債券發行量急遽增加，也正在與各國政府競爭資本，但殖利率上升有一部分可能反映市場對經濟成長加速的預期。

全球公共債務問題日益嚴重

喬治艾娃表示，全球公共債務接近二戰以來最高水準，且很快將超過GDP的100%，其中已開發經濟體是「最嚴重的違規者」。
她直言，過去17年來，各國政府「過得相對輕鬆」，因為利率一直低於經濟成長率，「如今利率走升結束了這種局面。」
她指出，利率與經濟成長之間的差距目前「遠不如過去有利」，且「預料將進一步擴大」，這意味著若不採取財政措施，光靠經濟成長來實現要降低債務比率所需的成長幅度，短期內已「遙不可及」。
殖利率帶來的壓力已經在歐洲浮現。德國公債(Bund)與其他國家公債的利差正在擴大，不僅法國與義大利如此，愛爾蘭、葡萄牙等在歐債危機後已降低債務與赤字的國家也面臨類似情況。
喬治艾娃表示，由於一連串衝擊導致公共債務膨脹，而且多數國家的財政赤字仍高於疫情前平均水準，「財政空間迫切需要補充」。

AI金融風險可能被低估

喬治艾娃也指出，AI熱潮本身存在金融穩定風險。她表示，強勁的企業獲利正在推升股價與財富效應，但如果獲利不如預期，超大規模資料中心業者(hyperscaler)的槓桿，以及全球持有大量且持續增加的美股部位，都可能讓一次失望轉變成影響深遠的衝擊。
她引用了「阿馬拉定律」(Amara’s Law)——指人們往往高估新科技的短期影響，卻低估長期影響：在「今日AI建設熱潮」與「明日AI效益到來」之間的轉換過程中，全球將經歷「風險最高的時期」。
喬治艾娃認為，第一道防線是監管與監督，「現在可能是許多國家的貨幣政策採取審慎偏鷹立場的好時機。
paras_en: IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva said that investors and governments are banking on artificial intelligence (AI) to boost the global economy, but it is increasingly putting pressure on growth, and she urged policymakers not to postpone tackling thorny debt issues.

Georgieva told an event in Singapore on Wednesday (the 7th) that AI "is rapidly becoming a key driver of each country's relative fate in the global economy," yet the fast‑moving AI, soaring energy costs and record‑high public debt together challenge an already "less than ideal" century‑long growth trajectory.
Georgieva said: "Whether you love, dislike or fear AI, it is already here."

The global economy is being pulled in two directions. On the eve of a series of annual meetings by the IMF and World Bank next week, Georgieva described the world economy as being tugged by two forces: on one hand, the eight‑month‑old Middle‑East war delivering a "negative energy‑supply shock," and on the other, the AI investment boom creating a "positive demand shock." She said the combined impact is "extremely uneven across the globe."

On the positive side, AI investment as a share of GDP could reach, or even surpass, the scale of investment during the railway, power‑grid or telecom‑network building eras. She noted that AI hardware and related tech products already account for more than ten percent of global merchandise trade.

The IMF estimates that, if AI develops well, it could lift the global annual growth rate by up to 0.5 percentage points. Georgieva said: "Moving from 3% to 3.5% over ten years is like adding an economy the size of ASEAN to the world economy."

However, the benefits of AI may be highly concentrated. She said the boom largely bypasses economies that are less involved in the global AI supply chain, thereby "increasing the risk of widening global economic inequality."

The boom also intensifies inflation concerns that governments from the United States and Europe to Asia have been grappling with. She said, "The AI construction boom has inflationary properties," as do energy and food shocks, tariffs and defence spending.

As the Middle‑East conflict drags on with little sign of diplomatic resolution, oil prices have stayed above $100 a barrel. Tight refining capacity is squeezing energy supply, pushing retail diesel prices to historic highs.

These inflationary pressures are feeding directly into bond markets, with yields on U.S., German and Japanese bonds soaring to their highest levels in decades. Georgieva said AI‑related borrowers have seen a sharp rise in long‑term private bond issuance, competing with sovereigns for capital, while part of the yield rise may reflect market expectations of faster growth.

Global public debt is becoming increasingly severe. Georgieva said public debt worldwide is near its highest level since World War II and will soon exceed 100% of GDP, with developed economies being the "worst violators."
She bluntly noted that for the past 17 years governments have "had it relatively easy" because interest rates stayed below growth rates, "but rising rates have ended that situation."

She added that the gap between rates and growth is now "far less favorable than before" and is expected to widen further, meaning that without fiscal action, relying on growth alone to lower debt‑to‑GDP ratios is "far out of reach" in the short term.

Yield‑driven pressure is already showing in Europe. The spread between German Bunds and other sovereign bonds is widening, affecting not only France and Italy but also Ireland, Portugal and other countries that reduced debt and deficits after the Euro‑area crisis.
Georgieva said that a cascade of shocks has swollen public debt and that most countries' fiscal deficits remain above pre‑pandemic averages, so "fiscal space urgently needs to be replenished."

AI‑related financial risks may be underestimated. Georgieva warned that the AI boom itself carries financial‑stability risks. Strong corporate profits are lifting stock prices and wealth effects, but if earnings fall short, the leverage of hyperscale data‑center operators and the massive, growing U.S. equity positions held globally could turn a disappointment into a far‑reaching shock.

She cited Amara’s Law – the tendency to overestimate short‑term impacts of new tech while underestimating long‑term effects – noting that the transition from today’s AI construction boom to tomorrow’s AI benefits will be the "period of highest risk" globally.
Georgieva sees the first line of defence as regulation and supervision, adding that now may be a good time for many countries’ monetary authorities to adopt a cautiously hawkish stance.

items.title: AI熱潮下誰在大賣股？輝達董事套現近9.5億美元居冠
items.title_en: Who Is Cashing Out the Most Shares Amid the AI Boom? Nvidia Director Leads with About $950 Million
paras: AI投資熱潮持續延燒，相關企業富豪也在第三季大舉賣股。根據追蹤內部人交易的Washington Service統計，輝達(NVDA-US)董事史蒂文斯(Mark Stevens)單季出售約9.47億美元股票，居內部人賣股金額之冠；Arista Networks(ANET-US)董事長暨執行長烏拉爾(Jayshree Ullal)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)創辦人貝佐斯也名列前十。
這波賣股出現在科技股劇烈震盪之際。不過，榜上多筆交易依事先安排的交易計畫執行，部分人士出售後仍持有大量股份，不能僅憑賣股就認定他們看壞AI前景。

輝達董事賣股近9.5億美元 金額居冠

據《彭博》報導，史蒂文斯第三季出售約424萬股輝達股票，總值約9.47億美元。這位創投富豪身價約122億美元，售股後仍是輝達第二大個人股東，持股規模僅次於執行長黃仁勳。
輝達今年股價上漲近30%，但漲勢不及股價均已漲至原先三倍以上的英特爾(INTC-US)與超微(AMD-US)。由於獲利成長速度持續超越估值攀升幅度，輝達第三季估值一度接近十多年來最低水準，反映即使營收持續大增，華爾街仍抱持疑慮。
AI類股7月曾因市場擔心產業投入資金過於龐大而重挫，反彈後又在9月中旬遭遇壓力，當時Anthropic執行長阿莫戴與OpenAI執行長阿特曼呼籲放慢先進AI模型開發。
不過，隨著Meta(META-US)推出Muse，以及市場期待輝達下一代AI架構，許多相關股票很快收復失土。黃仁勳則反對放慢開發，直言此舉「完全沒有必要」。

貝佐斯與AI企業高層上榜 多筆依預定計畫執行

排名第二的烏拉爾第三季出售約223萬股Arista股票，總值約4.46億美元。交易主要在8月股價上漲期間，依10b5-1預定交易計畫執行，也就是事先訂定交易安排，再依計畫出售股票。她目前仍持有Arista約2%股權。
Arista受惠於資料中心大舉建置，帶動網路連接設備需求，公司8月初預估第三季營收達33億美元，優於分析師平均預期。
AI運算服務商CoreWeave(CRWV-US)董事長暨執行長英特拉托(Michael Intrator)以約3.47億美元賣股金額排名第五。自公司2025年上市以來，高層已透過預定交易計畫出售數十億美元持股。公司先前表示，相關交易是例行資金安排，高層仍對前景有信心。
英特拉托9月30日接受《CNBC》訪問時也強調，外界對資料中心擴建的反彈，並未影響公司業績，「訂單完全沒有減少」。
貝佐斯則以約3.46億美元排名第六，第三季依預定計畫出售約121萬股亞馬遜股票。他在2025年已出售2,500萬股，今年持續減持，並於8月申報計劃出售最多1,500萬股、價值逾40億美元的股票。

賣股潮擴及生技業 交易金額須搭配背景解讀

相較第二季主要賣家幾乎全與AI產業有關，第三季榜單也出現多位醫療與生技業人士。
Illumina(ILMN-US)董事梅斯特(Keith Meister)透過旗下避險基金Corvex Management出售約4.36億美元股票，排名第三，顯示榜單金額不一定全是個人直接套現。
United Therapeutics(UTHR-US)董事長暨執行長Martine Rothblatt以約3.14億美元排名第七；百濟神州(BeOne Medicines)(ONC-US)(06160-HK)(688235-CN)董事長暨執行長歐雷強(John Oyler)以約2.93億美元排名第八。兩人的出售均依預定交易計畫執行，歐雷強仍持有公司近5%股權。
其他上榜者包括排名第四的SharkNinja(SN-US)董事長王旭寧，出售約4.01億美元；排名第九的Rocket Lab(RKLB-US)董事長暨執行長貝克(Peter Beck)，出售約2.86億美元；以及排名第十的Snowflake(SNOW-US)董事長史洛特曼(Frank Slootman)，出售約2.83億美元。
這份統計包含董事代表所屬機構申報的出售，但排除透過公開發行進行的內部人售股。因此，評估這些交易時，仍須搭配預定交易安排、出售後持股與交易主體，不能將排行榜直接視為高層對產業前景的信心排名。
paras_en: The AI investment frenzy continues to blaze, and related corporate magnates are also selling large amounts of stock in the third quarter. According to Washington Service, which tracks insider trades, Nvidia (NVDA-US) director Mark Stevens sold roughly $947 million worth of shares in a single quarter, topping the list of insider sale amounts; Arista Networks (ANET-US) chairman and CEO Jayshree Ullal and Amazon (AMZN-US) founder Jeff Bezos also made the top ten.

These sales come as tech stocks experience sharp volatility. However, many of the transactions on the list were executed under pre‑arranged trading plans, and some individuals still hold large stakes after selling, so the sales alone do not prove they are bearish on AI’s outlook.

Nvidia director’s sale of nearly $950 million tops the list. Bloomberg reported that Stevens sold about 4.24 million Nvidia shares in Q3, worth roughly $947 million. The venture‑capital billionaire has a net worth of about $12.2 billion and remains Nvidia’s second‑largest individual shareholder, behind CEO Jensen Huang.

Nvidia’s stock has risen almost 30% this year, but its rally lags behind Intel (INTC-US) and AMD (AMD-US), whose shares have more than tripled. Because earnings growth continues to outpace valuation gains, Nvidia’s Q3 valuation briefly fell to its lowest level in over a decade, reflecting Wall Street’s lingering doubts despite soaring revenue.

AI stocks slumped in July as the market worried about the massive capital required for the sector, then rebounded before facing pressure again in mid‑September when Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman called for a slowdown in advanced AI model development.

Nevertheless, after Meta (META-US) launched Muse and the market anticipates Nvidia’s next‑gen AI architecture, many related stocks quickly reclaimed lost ground. Huang opposes slowing development, saying it is “completely unnecessary.”

Amazon founder Jeff Bezos and other AI‑industry executives also appear on the list, with many trades executed under pre‑planned schedules. Arista’s Ullal sold about 2.23 million shares in Q3, worth roughly $446 million, mainly during August’s price rise, under a 10b5‑1 plan, and she still holds about 2% of Arista.

Arista benefits from the massive build‑out of data centers, driving demand for networking equipment; the company projected Q3 revenue of $3.3 billion in early August, beating analysts’ average expectations.

CoreWeave (CRWV-US) chairman and CEO Michael Intrator ranked fifth with about $347 million in stock sales. Since the company’s 2025 IPO, executives have sold tens of billions of dollars of shares through scheduled plans. The firm said the trades are routine capital arrangements and that management remains confident about the outlook.
Intrator told CNBC on September 30 that the rebound in data‑center expansion has not affected the company’s performance, stating “orders have not decreased at all.”

Jeff Bezos ranked sixth with about $346 million, selling roughly 1.21 million Amazon shares in Q3 under a pre‑arranged plan. He sold 25 million shares in 2025, continues to reduce his stake this year, and filed in August to sell up to 15 million shares worth over $4 billion.

The selling wave extends into biotech, and transaction amounts must be read in context. Compared with Q2, when sellers were almost exclusively tied to AI, the Q3 list also features several figures from the medical and biotech sectors.

Illumina (ILMN-US) director Keith Meister sold about $436 million worth of stock through his hedge fund Corvex Management, ranking third, showing that the list’s amounts are not always direct personal cash‑outs.

United Therapeutics (UTHR-US) chairman and CEO Martine Rothblatt sold roughly $314 million, ranking seventh; BeOne Medicines (ONC-US) (06160-HK) (688235-CN) chairman and CEO John Oyler sold about $293 million, ranking eighth. Both trades were executed under scheduled plans, and Oyler still holds nearly 5% of the company.

Other entrants include SharkNinja (SN-US) chairman Wang Xuning, who sold about $401 million, ranking fourth; Rocket Lab (RKLB-US) chairman and CEO Peter Beck, who sold about $286 million, ranking ninth; and Snowflake (SNOW-US) chairman Frank Slootman, who sold about $283 million, ranking tenth.

The statistics cover sales reported by directors on behalf of their institutions but exclude insider sales made through public offerings. Therefore, when evaluating these trades, one must consider the scheduled trading arrangements, post‑sale holdings, and the parties involved, rather than treating the ranking as a direct confidence gauge of industry prospects.

items.title: 馬斯克想大買輝達晶片！SpaceX傳籌400億美元 股債先承壓
items.title_en: Musk Wants to Buy Nvidia Chips in Bulk! SpaceX Said to Seek $40 Billion, Stocks and Bonds Under Pressure
paras: SpaceX(SPCX-US)傳出正洽談籌資400億美元，用於購買輝達(NVDA-US)AI晶片，融資規模與細節引發市場關注。消息傳出後，SpaceX周三(7日)早盤股價下跌2%，公司債也遭拋售，信用風險指標升至新高。
綜合外媒報導，知情人士透露，這家由馬斯克掌舵的企業正與銀行及資產管理公司磋商，計劃透過約100億美元銀行貸款及300億美元投資等級債務，為晶片採購籌措資金。其中一名消息人士表示，SpaceX正與資產管理公司PIMCO洽談融資。
《金融時報》另報導，阿波羅全球管理(APO-US)預計主導這筆交易，協助向廣泛投資人銷售相關債務。SpaceX與輝達未立即回應置評請求，阿波羅與PIMCO則不予評論。據先前《彭博》報導，磋商仍處初期階段，最終可能不會達成協議。
若成功籌得400億美元，這筆交易將成為歷來規模最大的AI基礎建設債務融資案之一，也凸顯科技企業競相取得先進晶片、擴充運算設施所需的龐大資金。
馬斯克上月表示，xAI的Colossus 2資料中心使用的輝達晶片數量，到12月可能增至目前的兩倍以上，並稱公司計劃全數採用輝達硬體建置資料中心。SpaceX今年6月才透過規模創紀錄的首次公開發行(IPO)籌得860億美元。輝達周三早盤股價則上漲0.5%。
不過，潛在融資需求已引發債市疑慮。根據ICE Data Services數據，SpaceX五年期信用違約交換(CDS)報價周三盤中一度上升14.3個基點，至每年約195.2個基點，創相關合約自6月開始活躍交易以來的盤中新高。CDS可用於對沖債務違約風險，報價上升代表取得信用保障的成本增加。
公司債同樣承壓。Trace數據顯示，截至美東時間周三上午8時52分，SpaceX票面利率6.65%、2056年到期的公司債，利差擴大10個基點至236個基點，明顯高於6月發行時的175個基點。公司當時透過發行五種不同到期年限的公司債，籌得250億美元。
摩根士丹利(MS-US)估計，到2028年，AI基礎建設將需要1.5兆美元外部融資，但放款機構與投資人對資助產業擴張已愈來愈謹慎。
輝達則在8月與阿波羅、貝萊德(BLK-US)、黑石(BX-US)、布魯克菲爾德、​​高盛(GS-US)及KKR(KKR-US)合作，透過融資平台，目標為AI基礎建設計畫動員逾5,000億美元資金。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) is reportedly in talks to raise $40 billion to purchase Nvidia (NVDA-US) AI chips, a financing plan that has drawn market attention. After the news broke, SpaceX shares fell 2% on Wednesday morning (the 7th), and the company’s bonds were sold off, pushing its credit risk indicator to a new high.

According to foreign media reports, insiders say the Musk‑led firm is negotiating with banks and asset managers, planning roughly $10 billion in bank loans and $30 billion of investment‑grade debt to fund the chip purchase. One source added that SpaceX is in talks with asset manager PIMCO on financing.

The Financial Times reported that Apollo Global Management (APO-US) is expected to lead the deal, helping sell the related debt to a broad investor base. SpaceX and Nvidia did not immediately respond to comment requests, and Apollo and PIMCO declined to comment. A prior Bloomberg report said the talks are still in early stages and may ultimately not result in an agreement.

If the $40 billion is successfully raised, the transaction would become one of the largest AI infrastructure debt financings ever, underscoring the massive capital needs of tech firms racing to acquire advanced chips and expand computing facilities.

Musk said last month that the number of Nvidia chips used in xAI’s Colossus 2 data center could more than double by December, and that the company plans to build its data centers entirely with Nvidia hardware. SpaceX raised a record $86 billion in June through its inaugural public offering. Nvidia’s shares rose 0.5% in early trading on Wednesday.

However, the potential financing need has raised concerns in the bond market. ICE Data Services data show SpaceX’s five‑year credit default swap (CDS) price rose 14.3 basis points mid‑day on Wednesday to about 195.2 bps per annum, a intraday high since the contract became actively traded in June. A higher CDS price means the cost of obtaining credit protection has increased.

Company bonds are also under pressure. Trace data indicate that as of 8:52 a.m. Eastern Time on Wednesday, SpaceX’s 6.65% senior notes due 2056 saw their spread widen by 10 bps to 236 bps, well above the 175 bps spread at issuance in June when the company raised $25 billion by issuing five tranches of notes with different maturities.

Morgan Stanley (MS-US) estimates that by 2028 AI infrastructure will require $1.5 trillion of external financing, but lenders and investors are becoming increasingly cautious about funding industry expansion.

Nvidia, in August, partnered with Apollo, BlackRock (BLK-US), Blackstone (BX-US), Brookfield, Goldman Sachs (GS-US) and KKR (KKR-US) through a financing platform, aiming to mobilize over $500 billion for AI infrastructure projects.

items.title: OpenAI公布青少年ChatGPT使用報告！安全防護遭獨立測試打問號
items.title_en: OpenAI Releases Teen ChatGPT Usage Report; Independent Test Questions Safety Alerts
paras: OpenAI周三(7日)發布首份青少年使用報告，表示青少年平均每天使用ChatGPT不到15分鐘，連續聊天超過三小時的比例低於2%。在AI聊天機器人對未成年人的心理健康與成長影響受到關注之際，公司希望透過數據說明使用管理措施的成效，但另一份獨立測試報告則質疑，ChatGPT青少年版本的家長警示機制未能及時發揮作用。
據《路透》報導，OpenAI表示，在出現休息提醒的青少年對話中，近半數使用者於五分鐘內暫停或結束聊天。能使用青少年專屬版本的用戶，也傳送更多教育相關訊息，並使用學習視覺化工具與Study Mode學習模式。
青少年版本強化學習功能 使用管理成效受檢視
OpenAI自8月起陸續推出ChatGPT for Teens，系統會依據年齡資料，或判斷使用者可能未滿18歲時，自動啟用青少年模式，提供家長控制功能，並限制敏感議題的對話。
公司也正規劃新增大學申請工具，協助學生整理申請條件、截止日期與助學金申請步驟，另將加入學習卡片及更方便製作測驗的功能，擴大ChatGPT在學習上的用途。
隨著AI平台快速普及，外界愈來愈關注這些工具對青少年心理健康與成長安全的影響。社群媒體對年輕用戶的傷害研究，也加深了相關疑慮。
Meta(META-US)今年8月同意支付最高180億美元，並限制青少年使用Facebook與Instagram，以和解外界指控其刻意將平台設計成讓兒童成癮的訴訟，凸顯科技業面臨的未成年人保護壓力。
獨立測試質疑警示延誤 OpenAI稱控制功能可能尚未啟用
非營利組織Common Sense Media周三發布報告指出，當青少年帳號談及自殺、自傷或飲食失調時，ChatGPT for Teens經常延遲通知家長，甚至完全沒有發出警示。
這項研究使用十多個專為測試建立的帳號，也發現聊天機器人未能穩定地建議使用者聯絡危機求助專線，或尋求專業協助。
OpenAI發言人回應，測試並未「準確反映」ChatGPT青少年防護機制的運作方式。公司表示，基於安全與服務規模等因素，家長與青少年帳號完成連結，以及安全警示功能正式啟用，可能需要數小時。
發言人指出：「他們大部分測試可能在家長控制功能尚未完成啟用前，就已開始並結束。」
Common Sense Media則表示，部分測試帳號確實未連結足夠時間，但另一些帳號已等待足夠久，仍沒有任何帳號及時發出警示。該組織指出，只有累積數周敏感議題對話紀錄的帳號，最後才收到通知。
paras_en: OpenAI on Wednesday (the 7th) released its first teen usage report, stating that teenagers average less than 15 minutes per day on ChatGPT and less than 2% chat continuously for over three hours. As concerns grow over AI chatbots’ impact on minors’ mental health and development, the company hopes data will demonstrate the effectiveness of usage‑management measures, but another independent test report questions whether the parental warning system in the teen version of ChatGPT is acting promptly.

According to Reuters, OpenAI said that among teen conversations that trigger a break reminder, nearly half of users pause or end the chat within five minutes. Users who can access the teen‑only version also send more education‑related messages and use visual learning tools and the Study Mode learning mode.
Teen version strengthens learning features; usage‑management effectiveness under review

OpenAI has been rolling out ChatGPT for Teens since August; the system automatically enables teen mode based on age data or when it judges a user may be under 18, providing parental controls and restricting conversations on sensitive topics.

The company is also planning to add a college‑application tool to help students organize requirements, deadlines and financial‑aid steps, as well as learning cards and easier quiz‑creation features, expanding ChatGPT’s role in education.

As AI platforms spread rapidly, external observers are increasingly focused on how these tools affect teen mental health and safety. Research on social‑media harm to young users has deepened related concerns.

Meta (META‑US) agreed in August to pay up to $18 billion and restrict teen use of Facebook and Instagram to settle lawsuits accusing the company of deliberately designing its platforms to be addictive for children, highlighting the pressure on tech firms to protect minors.
Independent test questions delayed alerts; OpenAI says control features may not yet be active

Non‑profit Common Sense Media released a report on Wednesday noting that when teen accounts discuss suicide, self‑harm or eating disorders, ChatGPT for Teens often delays notifying parents, and sometimes fails to issue any warning at all.
The study used more than a dozen accounts created specifically for testing and also found the chatbot inconsistently suggested users contact crisis hotlines or seek professional help.

An OpenAI spokesperson responded that the test does not "accurately reflect" how the teen protection mechanisms operate. The company said that, due to safety and service‑scale considerations, linking parent and teen accounts and fully activating safety alerts may take several hours.
The spokesperson added, "Most of their tests likely began and ended before the parental‑control feature was fully enabled."

Common Sense Media said some test accounts indeed were not linked long enough, but other accounts waited sufficiently long yet still received no timely alerts. The organization noted that only accounts with weeks‑long records of sensitive‑topic conversations eventually received a notification.

items.title: 不靠雲端也能寫程式！微軟攜輝達推AI筆電 記憶體漲價卻來攪局
items.title_en: You Can Code Without the Cloud! Microsoft Teams with Nvidia to Launch AI Laptop, Memory Price Hikes Disrupt the Play
paras: 微軟(MSFT-US)周三(7日)發表可直接在個人電腦執行的AI程式設計模型，以及防止AI代理未經授權存取資料的新安全技術，並攜手輝達(NVDA-US)推出新款Surface筆電，挑戰蘋果(AAPL-US)將更多AI功能搬進個人裝置的布局。不過，記憶體價格飆升推高硬體成本，也讓這場競爭面臨價格考驗。
據《路透》報導，微軟在舊金山活動中展示Windows與Surface產品更新，希望讓AI代理直接在桌機或筆電上撰寫程式、處理複雜企業專案，減少對雲端運算的依賴。

攜手輝達推新筆電 安全工具管住AI代理權限

微軟執行長納德拉與輝達執行長黃仁勳共同登台，介紹搭載輝達晶片的Surface Laptop Ultra。這項成果來自雙方多年合作，藉由輝達RTX Spark晶片，將更多AI工作帶到個人電腦上。
微軟同時推出Microsoft Execution Containers，透過隔離執行環境，防止AI代理在電腦上擅自存取資料或執行未獲授權的任務。Windows與裝置部門執行副總裁Pavan Davuluri表示，Anthropic、OpenAI及輝達都將使用這套工具。
Davuluri指出，新工具可讓企業資訊部門替AI代理設定規則，再由Windows於每位員工的電腦上落實。納德拉強調：「我們必須讓桌面環境成為代理執行任務最安全的地方。」
能否將可自主處理複雜問題的AI代理，安全限制在授權範圍內，是微軟與輝達的重要挑戰。輝達希望避免AI平台Hugging Face遭駭事件重演，蘋果也正設法收緊授予AI代理完整Mac硬碟存取權限的流程。
對微軟而言，這項布局可將部分目前由昂貴Azure資料中心承擔的工作，移往企業與家庭的高效能Windows電腦，硬體成本則由客戶負擔。蘋果也透過新款Mac爭取這塊市場；輝達則有機會進軍長期由英特爾(INTC-US)與超微(AMD-US)主導的Windows個人電腦晶片市場。

記憶體漲價推高成本 AI搬進電腦面臨價格門檻

然而，分析師認為，新產品價格將是關鍵。記憶體供應吃緊，已推升桌機與筆電售價，削弱在個人電腦執行AI以節省成本的吸引力。
微軟兩年前最初提出這項構想時，相關筆電多數售價低於2,000美元。如今，輝達搭載128GB記憶體的AI桌機DGX Spark，近期卻因記憶體成本飆升，漲價約75%至6,950美元。
Moor Insights & Strategy分析師Anshel Sag表示，記憶體漲價同時影響蘋果與微軟的布局。兩年前是硬體到位、軟體尚未成熟，如今軟體準備好了，硬體卻貴到讓使用者難以負擔。他認為，直接在電腦上執行AI，正逐漸成為只有預算充足者才能享有的選項。
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) on Wednesday (the 7th) announced an AI programming model that can run directly on personal computers, along with new security technology to prevent unauthorized data access by AI agents, and partnered with Nvidia (NVDA-US) to launch a new Surface laptop, challenging Apple (AAPL-US) as it moves more AI features into personal devices. However, soaring memory prices are raising hardware costs and putting price pressure on the competition.

According to Reuters, Microsoft showcased updates to Windows and Surface at an event in San Francisco, aiming to let AI agents write code and handle complex enterprise projects on desktops or laptops, reducing reliance on cloud computing.

Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang jointly took the stage to introduce the Surface Laptop Ultra powered by Nvidia chips. The product stems from years of collaboration, using Nvidia’s RTX Spark processor to bring more AI workloads to personal computers.

Microsoft also unveiled Microsoft Execution Containers, which use isolated execution environments to stop AI agents from accessing data or running unauthorized tasks on a computer. Windows and Devices division EVP Pavan Davuluri said Anthropic, OpenAI and Nvidia will all use the tool.

Davuluri noted the new tool lets corporate IT set rules for AI agents, which Windows then enforces on each employee’s machine. Nadella emphasized, “We must make the desktop the safest place for agents to execute tasks.”

Keeping AI agents that can autonomously tackle complex problems within authorized limits is a key challenge for Microsoft and Nvidia. Nvidia wants to avoid a repeat of the Hugging Face hack, while Apple is tightening the process that grants AI agents full Mac hard‑drive access.

For Microsoft, the strategy could shift work that currently runs in expensive Azure data centers onto high‑performance Windows PCs in enterprises and homes, with hardware costs borne by customers. Apple is also targeting this market with new Macs; Nvidia sees an opening to enter the Windows PC chip market long dominated by Intel (INTC-US) and AMD (AMD-US).
Analysts say pricing will be critical. Tight memory supply has already pushed up desktop and laptop prices, weakening the cost‑saving appeal of running AI on personal computers.

When Microsoft first floated the idea two years ago, most of the related laptops were priced under $2,000. Today, Nvidia’s AI workstation DGX Spark equipped with 128 GB of memory has jumped about 75% to $6,950 due to soaring memory costs.

Moor Insights & Strategy analyst Anshel Sag said the memory price surge is affecting both Apple’s and Microsoft’s plans. Two years ago the hardware was affordable but the software immature; now the software is ready but the hardware is so pricey that only well‑funded users can afford to run AI directly on a PC.

items.title: Fed會議紀錄：升息還沒完！多數官員估年底前再一次 10月不一定出手
items.title_en: Fed Meeting Minutes: Rate Hikes Not Over Yet – Most Officials Expect One More Increase Before Year‑End, October Action Uncertain
paras: 聯準會(Fed)周三(7日)公布9月會議紀錄，顯示19名與會官員全數支持當月升息，多數也認為年底前可能還需再升息一次，但對升息理由與後續緊縮步調仍有不同看法。紀錄未透露10月必須接續行動的明確意向，官員強調，將依新數據與風險變化逐次決策。
綜合外媒報導，Fed在9月15至16日會議全員一致通過升息1碼(25個基點)，將聯邦資金利率目標區間調至3.75%至4%，為2023年7月以來首次升息。決策背景是通膨持續高於2%目標、勞動市場接近充分就業，且整體經濟成長動能有所增強。

全員支持升息 決策理由仍有分歧

會議紀錄顯示，支持同一項決策，不代表官員對經濟與政策的判斷完全一致。許多官員認為，從風險管理角度出發，提高利率路徑是審慎之舉，可防範需求強於預期，或供給再受衝擊，導致通膨長期高於目標。
部分官員則認為，目前的經濟與物價展望本身，已足以支持升息，反映他們對通膨持續偏高的擔憂。另有官員著重避免能源等價格衝擊擴散，還有兩名官員認為，中性利率估計值已提高，因此有必要調升政策利率。
這些差異意味著，部分官員將9月升息視為預防性措施，另一些則認為，需求動能已需要更積極的政策抑制。數名官員直言，升息前的利率「不具限制性，或僅具輕微限制性」，也有數人指出，經濟基本動能似乎已增強。
主席華許在9月16日會後形容，升息旨在收回「部分寬鬆」，帶動市場一度押注10月再升息。川普則批評這項決策，將責任歸咎於華許的同僚，稱他們「非常政治化」。

年底再升一次仍是主流 10月是否行動未定

紀錄指出，多數與會官員認為，年底前可能仍適合再調高利率，但也強調，對每次會議均保持開放態度，未來決策將取決於新資訊對經濟展望與風險平衡的影響。
9月提交預測的18名官員中，16人預期年底前還會升息，整體預測指向今年再升一次、2027年不再調升，少數則預估10月與12月都會行動。華許自5月上任以來，尚未提交利率預測。
不過，會後公布的就業與通膨數據低於預期，加上Fed副主席傑佛森、紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯上周均表示，央行有時間評估經濟、不必急於再升息，市場因而大幅調降10月行動的押注。
聯邦資金期貨顯示，周三市場預估10月27至28日會議再升1碼的機率約20%，低於9月決策後數日的約70%，目前較傾向12月8至9日會議再採取行動。對政策敏感的2年期美債殖利率，過去一周也下滑逾10個基點至約4.8%。
但10月14日將公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)，仍可能改變預期。若多數官員決定10月按兵不動，主張更快升息者可能投下反對票，包括7月曾反對維持利率不變的三名官員。

AI投資增添物價壓力 金融情勢仍支持成長

8月個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)年增3.4%，核心PCE年增3%，雖低於預期，且部分受計算方式調整影響，但仍明顯高於Fed目標。紐約聯準銀行最新調查也顯示，一年期通膨預期升至2023年5月以來最高，凸顯物價疑慮尚未消退。
官員普遍認為通膨風險偏向上行。AI基礎建設持續推升企業投資，數名官員指出，其規模與速度一再超出預期；部分官員則擔心，中期而言，這股熱潮可能讓整體需求成長超越供給，對物價形成上行壓力。
部分官員表示，能源漲價與AI建設正推升運輸及原物料成本，相關產業對技術人才的強勁需求，也帶動這些工作者的薪資大幅成長。數名官員並觀察到，隨著關稅影響逐漸減弱，AI建設對核心商品價格的推升作用似乎正在增強。
會議也討論長天期美債殖利率上升，原因包括市場預期Fed進一步升息，以及經濟數據強勁。紀錄引述市場看法指出，企業為AI基礎建設大舉舉債、競逐資金，加上地緣政治發展與財政部回購公債計畫的不確定性，也可能推升期限溢酬與美債殖利率。
不過，許多官員認為，即使長債殖利率走高，金融情勢仍支持經濟成長，因為今年股價大幅上漲，公司債利差也維持狹窄，顯示市場融資環境尚未明顯收緊。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve released the September meeting minutes on Wednesday (the 7th), showing that all 19 participating officials supported a rate hike that month. Most also think another hike may be needed before the end of the year, but they differ on the reasons for tightening and the pace of future policy. The minutes do not reveal a clear intent to act in October; officials stressed that decisions will be made step‑by‑step based on new data and changing risks.

According to foreign media reports, the Fed’s September 15‑16 meeting saw a unanimous vote to raise the target range for the federal funds rate by one quarter point (25 basis points) to 3.75%‑4%, the first hike since July 2023. The move was driven by inflation staying above the 2% goal, a labor market near full employment, and a pickup in overall economic momentum.

All members backed the same decision, but that does not mean they share identical views on the economy or policy. Many officials said that, from a risk‑management perspective, a higher rate path is prudent to guard against demand that outpaces expectations or supply shocks that could keep inflation above target for a long time.

Some officials argued that the current outlook for the economy and prices already justifies a hike, reflecting their concern that inflation remains too high. Others emphasized the need to prevent energy‑related price shocks from spreading, and two members said that the estimated neutral rate has risen, making a policy‑rate increase necessary.

These differences imply that some officials view the September hike as a preventive measure, while others see it as a response to already strong demand that needs more aggressive policy restraint. Several officials bluntly said that the pre‑hike rate was “not restrictive, or only mildly restrictive,” and a few noted that the underlying economic momentum appears to have strengthened.

Chair Jerome Powell described the hike on September 16 as a step to roll back “some of the accommodation,” which briefly sparked market bets on a further October hike. Former President Trump criticized the decision, blaming Powell’s colleagues and calling them “highly politicized.”

A majority of participants think another rate increase before year‑end is still appropriate, but the minutes stress that each meeting will remain open‑minded and future actions will depend on how new information reshapes the economic outlook and risk balance.

Of the 18 officials who submitted forecasts in September, 16 expect another hike before the end of the year, pointing to one more increase this year and none after 2027; a few forecast actions in both October and December. Powell has not submitted a rate forecast since taking office in May.

However, post‑meeting employment and inflation data came in below expectations, and both Fed Vice Chair Philip Jefferson and New York Fed President John Williams said last week that the central bank has time to assess the economy and does not need to rush another hike, prompting markets to sharply cut bets on an October move.

Federal funds futures on Wednesday showed the market assigning roughly a 20% chance to a one‑point hike at the Oct 27‑28 meeting, down from about 70% in the days after the September decision, with more focus now on a possible action at the Dec 8‑9 meeting. Policy‑sensitive two‑year Treasury yields have also fallen more than 10 basis points over the past week to around 4.8%.

Nevertheless, the CPI report due on Oct 14 could shift expectations. If most officials decide to hold in October, those favoring a faster pace may cast dissenting votes, including three members who opposed a rate hold back in July.

AI‑driven investment is adding price pressure, and financial conditions still support growth. August’s personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index rose 3.4% year‑over‑year, with core PCE up 3%—both below forecasts but still clearly above the Fed’s target, partly due to methodological adjustments.

Officials generally see inflation risks tilted to the upside. Ongoing AI infrastructure spending is boosting corporate investment, with several officials noting that its scale and speed repeatedly exceed expectations; some worry that, in the medium term, the AI boom could push overall demand growth beyond supply, creating upward price pressure.

Some officials said rising energy costs and AI build‑outs are lifting transportation and raw‑material expenses, and the strong demand for tech talent is driving large wage gains for those workers. Several also observed that as tariff impacts wane, AI construction appears to be exerting a growing upward influence on core commodity prices.

The meeting also covered the rise in long‑term Treasury yields, driven by market expectations of further Fed hikes and robust economic data. The minutes quoted market views that corporate borrowing for AI projects, geopolitical developments, and Treasury buy‑back plans add to term premia and push yields higher.

Yet many officials believe that even if long‑bond yields climb, financial conditions still support growth, as equity markets have surged this year and corporate bond spreads remain tight, indicating that financing conditions have not noticeably tightened.

items.title: 純電車加稅就改賣油電車？歐盟擬再出招 超額進口就課稅
items.title_en: EU Considers New Measures: Taxing Hybrid Imports After Raising Tariffs on Pure EVs
paras: 歐盟擬對中國油電混合車進口設限，防止中國車廠透過未被納入純電動車額外關稅的車款，持續擴大歐洲市占。據《彭博》報導，歐盟執委會正研擬防衛措施，可能採取關稅配額，對超過一定進口量的車輛加徵關稅，並將此案作為其他產業因應中國進口競爭的試金石。
消息帶動歐洲汽車股上漲，福斯盤中一度漲4.6%、雷諾漲6.1%，賓士漲2%。德國與法國尋求放寬歐盟燃油車規範的消息，也為類股提供支撐。

油電車未受額外關稅限制 中國進口量大增

歐盟2024年底對中國製純電動車加徵關稅，但油電混合車不適用相同的高額稅率，成為中國車廠擴張的重要途徑。目前，中國製車輛已占歐洲油電混合車銷量約四分之一，在插電式油電混合車市場的占比更達三分之一。
據《金融時報》數據，歐盟每月進口中國油電混合車的數量，從2024年10月的3,800輛，攀升至2026年7月的5萬輛，增至約13倍。
Dataforce數據顯示，中國品牌8月占歐洲新車領牌量11.7%，高於一年前的7.1%，創歷史新高。其中，比亞迪(002594-CN)(01211-HK)銷量年增128%，達26,007輛。
歐盟擬議的進口限制將設有期限，若成效符合預期，可能擴大至其他面臨中國進口激增的產業。不過，如何控制措施強度、避免北京報復，也成為政策設計的考量。

德國汽車生產連月下滑 政策成效仍受質疑

歐盟研擬措施之際，德國工業表現持續疲弱。8月工廠訂單月減10.6%，遠差於預期的1%，主要受到前月飛機、船舶、鐵路與軍用車輛大型訂單激增後回落影響。排除大型合約的三個月訂單仍下滑2.6%，顯示需求疲弱不只是單月波動。
德國8月工業生產雖月增2%，優於預期的0.5%，但主要靠營建活動成長9.3%帶動；汽車產量繼7月下滑9.2%後，再減少5.4%。
德意志銀行(DB-US)形容，歐洲製造業正面臨「第二波中國衝擊」，德國是歐盟大型經濟體中曝險最高者。中國占全球汽車出口的比重，已從2013年的5%升至2025年的15%，與德國並列。
不過，德銀預期，塞夫科維奇本周與王文濤會談難有重大突破。中國可能在市場開放上讓步，但限制對歐出口的進展有限。德銀研判，歐盟峰會後可能對中國插電式油電混合車啟動反補貼調查，最快2027年初才會加徵關稅。
高盛(GS-US)歐洲交易部門也認為，相關措施並非新構想，歐方仍顧慮中國反制，即使落實，恐怕也只能暫時壓抑中國車廠市占擴張。北京先前則批評，自願出口限制的提議嚴重違反世界貿易組織(WTO)規則。
paras_en: The EU is planning to limit imports of Chinese plug‑in hybrid vehicles to prevent Chinese automakers from expanding their market share in Europe by using models that are not subject to the additional tariffs imposed on pure electric cars. Bloomberg reports that the European Commission is drafting defensive measures that could include tariff quotas, imposing duties on vehicles that exceed a certain import volume, and using this case as a benchmark for other sectors facing competition from Chinese imports.

The news lifted European auto stocks, with Volkswagen briefly up 4.6% intraday, Renault up 6.1% and Mercedes‑Benz up 2%. Reports that Germany and France are seeking to relax EU fuel‑car regulations also provided support for the sector.

Hybrid vehicles are not subject to the extra tariffs, and Chinese import volumes have surged. While the EU will levy duties on Chinese‑made pure EVs at the end of 2024, plug‑in hybrids escape the high rates, giving Chinese manufacturers a key growth avenue. Currently Chinese‑made cars account for about a quarter of Europe’s hybrid sales and roughly a third of the plug‑in hybrid market.
According to Financial Times data, the EU’s monthly imports of Chinese plug‑in hybrids rose from 3,800 units in October 2024 to 50,000 units in July 2026 – an increase of about 13‑fold.

Dataforce shows Chinese brands captured 11.7% of new‑car registrations in Europe in August, up from 7.1% a year earlier, a record high. BYD (002594‑CN, 01211‑HK) alone saw sales jump 128% year‑on‑year to 26,007 units.

The proposed EU import limits would be time‑bound and could be expanded to other sectors if they prove effective against the surge of Chinese imports. However, calibrating the stringency of the measures and avoiding retaliation from Beijing are key considerations in the policy design.

German auto production has been slipping for months, casting doubt on the impact of the policy. In August, German factory orders fell 10.6% month‑on‑month, far worse than the 1% decline expected, after a previous surge in large orders for aircraft, ships, rail and military vehicles receded. Even excluding those big contracts, three‑month orders were down 2.6%, indicating weak demand beyond a single‑month fluctuation.

German industrial output grew 2% in August, beating the 0.5% forecast, but the gain was driven mainly by a 9.3% rise in construction activity; auto production, after a 9.2% drop in July, fell another 5.4%.

Deutsche Bank (DB‑US) described Europe’s manufacturing sector as facing a “second wave of Chinese shock,” with Germany the most exposed large EU economy. China’s share of global auto exports has risen from 5% in 2013 to an expected 15% in 2025, on par with Germany’s share.

However, Deutsche Bank expects little progress in talks between Czech President Petr Smejkal and Chinese Vice‑Premier Wang Wentao this week. China may concede on market‑access issues, but any limits on exports to Europe will be modest. The bank forecasts that after the EU summit, an anti‑subsidy probe into Chinese plug‑in hybrids could start, with tariffs unlikely to be imposed until early 2027 at the earliest.

Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) Europe trading desk says the proposed steps are not new ideas; Europe remains wary of Chinese retaliation, and even if implemented, the measures may only temporarily curb Chinese automakers’ market‑share expansion. Beijing has previously criticised the voluntary export‑restriction proposal as a serious breach of World Trade Organization rules.

items.title_en: TWD: Thin trading and cautious sentiment, closes at 31.795, down 0.014
paras: 新台幣今(7)日持續呈升貶互見走勢，由於台股上攻5萬點近關情怯，匯市量縮觀望氣氛也趨於濃厚，終場收在31.795元，貶值1.4分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值13.74億美元。
新台幣今日以31.8元、貶值1.9分開出後，一度升值至31.76元，但全日多處在走弱態勢，最低來到31.821元，高低價差6.1分。
觀察主要亞幣，由於美元指數強彈達0.4%，非美貨幣全面走弱，泰銖貶0.4%，星元貶逾0.2%，日元和人民幣貶0.1%左右，新台幣收貶0.04%。
統一投顧分析，儘管市場聚焦中東情勢發展，並關注本周聯準會將發布9月會議記錄，不過，IEA宣布釋放1億桶戰略儲油，短線有助油價趨向穩定。
另一方面，AI熱潮驅動企業投資與經濟穩健成長，美國9月ISM製造業新訂單加速擴張，隨著第三季財報季將在下周登場，統計機構持續上修獲利展望，有利美股多頭格局，並進一步穩固台股下檔支撐。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar continued a mixed up‑and‑down pattern today (the 7th), as the Taiwan stock index’s push toward the 50,000‑point mark sparked nervousness near the close. The foreign‑exchange market’s thin trading and cautious mood also intensified, and the dollar ended at NT$31.795, down 0.014, with Taipei’s foreign‑exchange brokers handling US$13.74 billion in transactions.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at NT$31.8, down 0.019, then briefly appreciated to NT$31.76, but spent most of the day weakening, hitting a low of NT$31.821. The intraday range was 0.061 NT$.

Looking at the major Asian currencies, the US dollar index jumped 0.4%, causing non‑US currencies to weaken across the board: the Thai baht fell 0.4%, the Singapore dollar slipped more than 0.2%, and both the Japanese yen and Chinese yuan weakened about 0.1%, while the New Taiwan dollar closed down 0.04%.

Unified Investment Advisory noted that although market focus remains on developments in the Middle East and on the Federal Reserve’s upcoming release of the September meeting minutes, the IEA’s announcement of releasing 100 million barrels from strategic reserves should help stabilize oil prices in the short term.

On the other hand, the AI boom is driving corporate investment and solid economic growth. US September ISM manufacturing new orders accelerated, and with the Q3 earnings season kicking off next week, statistical agencies are repeatedly raising profit forecasts, supporting a bullish US equity outlook and further bolstering support levels for the Taiwan stock market.

The ISM survey shows U.S. September services activity slowed, lowering the odds of a Federal Reserve rate hike in October and capping dollar gains. Meanwhile, Japanese Finance Minister Shigeyuki Katayama said on Tuesday that there are sufficient measures to meet next year’s budget needs. According to three sources familiar with the Bank of Japan’s thinking, the BOJ may signal this month that core inflation is roughly at its 2% target, indicating readiness to raise rates again in the coming months. BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda added that future policy adjustments will depend on the likelihood of achieving the baseline scenario and related risks. Additionally, LDP lawmaker Kenji Nakanishi believes Japan should greatly expand the sale of government bonds to household investors to build a more stable domestic investor base, supporting the yen. The dollar/yen slipped to a low of 157.75.

Subsequent U.S. data showed that a record‑high import surge driven by strong domestic demand widened the August trade deficit to $105.6 billion, exceeding expectations. The New York Fed noted that the global supply‑chain pressure index rose to 1.28 in September, potentially boosting inflationary pressure. The Fed is expected to hike rates once more before year‑end. San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly said that with rising inflation risks, last month’s support for a Fed hike was justified, and further hikes will hinge on inflation impacts. Kansas City Fed President Jeff Schmid believes the Fed still needs to raise policy rates further to curb inflation, pushing USD/JPY up to a high of 158.24. Today’s focus is the FOMC minutes, with USD/JPY support around 158.00‑158.20 and resistance near 159.00‑159.20.
EUR/USD

Yesterday New Zealand reported a Q3 business confidence index surge to 43, but expectations for a December RBNZ rate hike were already priced in. ANZ and job site Indeed found Australian September job ads rose 2.2% from August and 12.9% year‑on‑year, while the Westpac‑Melbourne Institute showed Australian consumer confidence fell to 80.4 in October, dampening the AUD and NZD. The euro slipped to a low of 1.1201 against the dollar, weighed down by French debt concerns.

歐元受到歐洲公債殖利率趨於穩定帶動。法國總統大選主要候選人之一、極右派「國民聯盟」領袖雷朋(Marine Le Pen)承諾，如果當選將大幅削減政府支出。此外，歐洲央行(ECB)一名官員也發表較為正面的談話，進一步支撐歐元。

paras_en: The dollar weakened on Tuesday (the 6th), retreating from an 18‑month high. With the euro rebounding and pressure on US Treasury sales easing, the dollar's rally paused.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.3% to 101.86 points, still hovering near its highest level since April 9, 2025.

The euro was buoyed by stabilising European sovereign yields. One of the main candidates in the French presidential race, far‑right National Rally leader Marine Le Pen, pledged to slash government spending dramatically if elected. In addition, an ECB official made relatively positive remarks, further supporting the euro.
The euro rose 0.3% against the dollar to $1.1259, breaking a recent string of declines. Previously, turbulence in the French bond market had put pressure on the euro.

France's 10‑year government bond yield has recently climbed to levels not seen since the early 2000s, driven by a severe fiscal and debt crisis. The spread between French 10‑year yields and German Bunds has also widened to its widest since the 2012 euro‑zone debt crisis.

France's fiscal deficit this year is projected at 5.4% of GDP, with public debt approaching 120% of GDP. The incumbent French government unveiled its 2027 budget last week, planning to cut €54 billion (about $60.79 billion) in spending to keep the deficit at 5% of GDP.
However, France also faces political uncertainty, with two rounds of the presidential election scheduled for April and May next year.
Leading candidate and far‑right leader Le Pen, together with party chief Jordan Bardella, announced their main budget policy proposals on Tuesday.

The euro also received a lift from comments by ECB chief economist Philip Lane. Lane said that while energy prices in the euro area remain high, they have not yet triggered a strong second‑round inflation effect. In an interview with Italy's ANSA on Tuesday, Lane stressed that the extent to which higher energy costs will feed through to overall prices remains highly uncertain.
Dollar rally pauses as Treasury buying returns.
With US Treasury yields falling, the dollar's advance has temporarily stalled.
The 10‑year US Treasury yield dropped 3.5 basis points to 5.278%, while the 30‑year yield slipped slightly to 5.661%. Both had recently risen to their highest levels since early 2002.

Market worries about oil‑driven inflation, corporations issuing large amounts of debt to build AI infrastructure, hawkish monetary policies from central banks, and ever‑growing sovereign debt have all intensified recent pressure on US Treasuries.
France's political and fiscal turmoil has further deepened market unease.
Even though expectations that the Federal Reserve will tighten policy have eased, the dollar remains at relatively elevated levels.
Recent inflation and employment data suggest the Fed may have some breathing room to keep rates unchanged for now.
When asked about the dollar’s strength against the euro, US President Donald Trump said it was because the United States "is performing well" and claimed a strong dollar "won’t cause inflation".

items.title: 關稅擋不住進口！美國8月貿易逆差衝上1056億美元 創逾一年最大

paras: 美國8月貿易逆差擴大至1,056億美元，創2025年初以來最大，且超出市場預期。AI建設帶動半導體與設備進口，加上能源成本上升及關稅政策干擾，推升進口額至歷史新高，貿易恐再度拖累第三季經濟成長。不過，強勁內需也顯示消費與企業投資仍具支撐力。
美國商務部周二(6日)公布，8月商品與服務貿易逆差較前月擴大13.7%，高於市場預估的約1,020億美元，7月逆差則修正為928億美元。8月進口月增4.3%至4,208億美元，出口僅增1.4%至3,152億美元，成長速度明顯落後。

AI建設拉動進口 半導體增額創紀錄

8月商品進口月增5.3%至3,422億美元，商品出口增加2.2%至2,057億美元。經通膨調整後，商品貿易逆差擴大至1,147億美元，為2025年3月以來最大。
包含電腦及周邊、半導體與電信設備的資本財進口，較前月增加62億美元。其中，半導體進口增加24億美元，創單月增額紀錄，民用飛機與電信設備進口也上升，反映AI投資熱潮持續仰賴海外供應。
包含石油及石油產品的工業原料進口增加91億美元，出口增加63億美元，其中原油出口增加20億美元。非貨幣性黃金進出口也同步增加。相較之下，服務出口大致持平，受訪美旅客支出降至2023年8月以來最低拖累。
美國第二季內需增速創逾三年半最快，消費與AI相關設備投資強勁。8月消費支出及核心資本財訂單、出貨數據顯示，這股動能延續至第三季，企業則持續依靠進口滿足需求。

貿易恐續拖累GDP 關稅未阻進口攀升

貿易已連續三季拖累美國國內生產毛額(GDP)，經濟學家估計，第三季拖累幅度可能達2.5個百分點。最新數據公布前，亞特蘭大聯準銀行GDPNow模型估計，淨出口將拉低第三季GDP成長率2.59個百分點，將是2025年初以來最大拖累。
不過，市場對第三季經濟成長率的預估多高於年率3%，預期消費支出可抵銷進口帶來的拖累，優於第二季的2.2%。
川普主張加徵關稅有助縮小逆差，但進口仍持續攀升。關稅變動、戰爭引發的油價波動及供應鏈挑戰，也使未經通膨調整的每月貿易數據劇烈起伏。
分國別來看，美國對加拿大商品逆差擴大至2025年初以來最高。8月貿易談判破局後，兩國企業搶在關稅生效前加速出貨；美國8月22日起對數十億美元加拿大商品課徵50%關稅，加拿大隨後反制。美國對墨西哥、越南的商品逆差均小幅擴大至新高，對半導體重要供應地台灣的逆差也增加。
paras_en: U.S. August trade deficit widened to $105.6 billion, the biggest since early 2025 and above market expectations. AI build‑out drove semiconductor and equipment imports, while higher energy costs and tariff policy disruptions pushed total imports to a historic high, threatening to again drag down third‑quarter economic growth. Nevertheless, strong domestic demand shows consumption and corporate investment remain supportive.

The U.S. Department of Commerce reported on Tuesday (the 6th) that the goods‑and‑services trade deficit for August expanded 13.7% from the prior month, exceeding the market forecast of roughly $102 billion; the July deficit was revised to $92.8 billion. August imports rose 4.3% month‑over‑month to $420.8 billion, while exports increased only 1.4% to $315.2 billion, a clearly slower growth rate.

AI construction pulled imports higher, with semiconductor imports hitting a record increase. August goods imports rose 5.3% month‑over‑month to $342.2 billion, while goods exports grew 2.2% to $205.7 billion. After inflation adjustment, the goods trade deficit expanded to $114.7 billion, the largest since March 2025.

Imports of capital goods—including computers and peripherals, semiconductors and telecom equipment—rose by $6.2 billion from the prior month. Semiconductor imports alone jumped $2.4 billion, setting a new single‑month increase record, while civil aircraft and telecom equipment imports also rose, reflecting the continued reliance on overseas supply for the AI investment boom.

Imports of industrial raw materials, including oil and petroleum products, increased by $9.1 billion, while exports rose $6.3 billion, with crude oil exports up $2.0 billion. Non‑monetary gold imports and exports also grew. By contrast, services exports were roughly flat, weighed down by U.S. visitor spending falling to its lowest level since August 2023.

U.S. domestic demand in the second quarter grew at the fastest pace in more than three and a half years, with strong consumer spending and AI‑related equipment investment. August consumer outlays and core capital‑goods orders and shipments indicate this momentum will carry into the third quarter, as firms continue to rely on imports to meet demand.

Trade has been a drag on U.S. gross domestic product (GDP) for three consecutive quarters, and economists estimate the third‑quarter drag could reach 2.5 percentage points. Ahead of the latest data release, the Atlanta Fed’s GDPNow model projected that net exports would shave 2.59 percentage points off third‑quarter GDP growth, the biggest drag since early 2025.

However, market forecasts for third‑quarter GDP growth are generally above an annualized 3%, with expectations that consumer spending will offset the import‑related drag, improving on the second quarter’s 2.2% rate.

Former President Trump argues that higher tariffs help narrow the deficit, yet imports keep climbing. Tariff changes, war‑driven oil‑price volatility and supply‑chain challenges also cause unadjusted monthly trade figures to swing sharply.

By country, the U.S. deficit with Canada rose to its highest level since early 2025. After trade talks broke down in August, firms in both nations rushed to ship goods before tariffs took effect; the U.S. imposed a 50% tariff on billions of dollars of Canadian goods starting August 22, prompting a Canadian retaliation. Deficits with Mexico and Vietnam also edged higher to new highs, and the deficit with Taiwan, a key semiconductor supplier, increased as well.

items.title_en: Stocks and Currency Surge! Bolsonaro Leads Brazil Presidential Election, Stock Market Jumps 9% to Six‑Year High, Real Rises 5%, 3× Leveraged ETN Soars 37%
paras: 由於參議員波索納洛在巴西大選首輪投票中意外領先現任總統魯拉，巴西資產大漲，雷亞爾一度飆升5%，股市創六年來最大單日漲幅，三倍做多巴西ETN更大漲37%。
當地時間周日(4日)晚上，巴西總統大選首輪投票結果出爐，前總統之子、自由黨候選人弗拉維奧·波索納洛以約47%得票率意外領先現任總統魯拉以約45%位居第二，兩人將於10月25日進行第二輪角逐。
波索納洛比魯拉更親市場，首輪表現好於預期，帶動巴西股市、匯市全線大漲，巴西基準股指Bovespa一度大漲超9%，創2022年以來最大漲幅，巴西雷亞爾狂升值逾5%。
花旗建議投資人加碼巴西股票和本幣債券的看漲押注。該行策略師在最新研報中寫道：「波索納洛是對市場更友善的候選人，承諾實施財政緊縮、私有化、放鬆監管以及下調增值稅，其政黨在參議院的強勁表現應有助於推動其立法議程獲得通過。」
預測市場定價也顯示，預期波索納洛在10月25日決選中獲勝的機率很高，花旗建議買入巴西股票以及2031年到期的政府債券，即所謂的NTN-F。
paras_en: Because Senate candidate Jair Bolsonaro unexpectedly led incumbent President Lula in the first round of Brazil's presidential election, Brazilian assets rallied sharply, the real spiked up to 5% and the stock market posted its biggest single‑day gain in six years, while a 3× long Brazil ETN surged another 37%.

On Sunday night local time (the 4th), the first‑round results of Brazil's presidential election were released: former president’s son and Liberal Party candidate Flávio Bolsonaro captured about 47% of the vote, unexpectedly ahead of incumbent President Lula who came second with roughly 45%, and the two will face off in a runoff on October 25.

Bolsonaro is seen as more market‑friendly than Lula, and his better‑than‑expected first‑round performance drove a broad rally in Brazil’s equities and foreign‑exchange markets. The benchmark Bovespa index surged more than 9% at one point, the biggest jump since 2022, while the Brazilian real appreciated by over 5%.

Citigroup recommends investors increase exposure to Brazilian equities and local‑currency bonds. In its latest research note, the bank’s strategists wrote: “Bolsonaro is a candidate more favorable to markets, pledging fiscal tightening, privatizations, deregulation and a cut to the value‑added tax; his party’s strong showing in the Senate should help push his legislative agenda through.”

Market pricing forecasts also show a high probability that Bolsonaro will win the October 25 runoff. Citigroup advises buying Brazilian stocks and government bonds maturing in 2031, the so‑called NTN‑F.

items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Slightly Up, Euro Falls to Near 17-Month Low on French Fiscal Concerns
paras: 美元周一(5日)小幅走高，主要受到歐元下跌的帶動。歐元一度跌至近17個月來最低水準，因市場對法國政府債務危機的擔憂升溫。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報102.14，創2025年4月9日以來最高。
歐元兌美元下跌0.3%，至1歐元兌1.1222美元，盤中一度跌至1.1161美元，為2025年5月16日以來最低。
歐洲外匯市場參與者正密切關注法國日益嚴重的財政衝擊。由於法國公共債務持續攀升，加上在明年總統大選前政治僵局嚴重，市場開始重新評估法國主權債券的風險溢價。
法國政府債券遭到猛烈拋售，兩年期公債殖利率單日大幅上升76個基點。同時，法國10年期 OAT國債與德國10年期Bund國債之間殖利率利差突破140個基點，創下2012年歐元區債務危機以來最大利差。
此外，法國5年期信用違約交換(CDS)價格飆升至87個基點，顯示外匯市場交易員正積極反映法國財政問題可能進一步蔓延至整個歐元區的風險。
法國上週公布了2027年度預算案，目標透過削減540億歐元(約605.9億美元)支出，將政府財政赤字控制在GDP的5%。然而，法國目前仍面臨嚴重財政問題。今年財政赤字預計將達GDP的5.4%，公共債務則接近GDP的120%。
美債拋售仍推升美元
在美國方面，美國公債遭到大量拋售，導致殖利率大幅上升。
10年期美國公債殖利率上升2.9個基點，至5.309%，30年期公債殖利率則上升3個基點，至5.660%。兩者目前都徘徊在數十年來高點附近。
上周，對利率變化較敏感的短天期美債曾稍微獲得喘息，因美國經濟數據公布後，市場對聯準會(Fed)即將升息的預期有所下降。
聯準會偏好的通膨指標最新數據顯示，年增率有所放緩，同時，意外疲弱的非農就業報告也顯示美國勞動市場可能正在稍微降溫。
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場預期本月底升息25個基點的機率，在上周結束時已降至約20%，而在該周初時還約為70%。
本周美國經濟數據相對清淡，市場主要關注聯準會上一次利率會議的會議紀要
周一，美國供應管理協會(ISM)公布9月服務業報告，顯示服務業經濟活動較8月放緩，但仍維持在代表擴張的區域。值得注意的是，服務業企業支付的價格指標在9月加速上升，創下2022年7月以來最高水準。
Lloyds Bank分析師表示，「本月初的數據相對清淡。這周主要焦點將是最終版的服務業與綜合PMI數據。這些數據應能提供更多歐元區經濟細節，並可能進一步說明能源價格上升所帶來的影響。此前公布的初步數據中，能源價格上漲的影響並不明顯。」

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Monday (the 5th), mainly driven by the euro's decline. The euro briefly slipped to its lowest level in almost 17 months as market worries over a French government debt crisis intensified.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 102.14, its highest since April 9, 2025.
The euro fell 0.3% against the dollar to €1 = $1.1222, briefly dropping to $1.1161, the lowest since May 16, 2025.

European FX market participants are closely watching France's worsening fiscal shock. With French public debt continuing to climb and a severe political deadlock ahead of next year’s presidential election, markets are reassessing the risk premium on French sovereign bonds.

French government bonds faced a sharp sell‑off, with the two‑year yield jumping 76 basis points in a single day. At the same time, the spread between France’s 10‑year OAT and Germany’s 10‑year Bund surged past 140 basis points, the widest gap since the euro‑area debt crisis of 2012.

Moreover, the price of France’s five‑year credit default swap spiked to 87 basis points, indicating that FX traders are actively pricing the risk that France’s fiscal problems could spread across the euro zone.

France unveiled its 2027 budget last week, aiming to cut €54 billion (about $60.59 billion) in spending and cap the fiscal deficit at 5% of GDP. However, France still faces serious fiscal challenges, with the current year’s deficit projected at 5.4% of GDP and public debt near 120% of GDP.
U.S. Treasury sell‑off continues to lift the dollar
In the United States, Treasury bonds have been sold off heavily, pushing yields sharply higher.
The 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield rose 2.9 basis points to 5.309%, while the 30‑year yield climbed 3 basis points to 5.660%. Both are now hovering near multi‑decade highs.
Last week, short‑term Treasuries, which are more sensitive to rate changes, briefly caught a breather as market expectations for further Fed hikes eased after U.S. economic data releases.
The Fed‑preferred inflation gauge showed a slowdown in the annual growth rate, and a surprisingly weak jobs report suggested the U.S. labor market may be cooling slightly.
According to the CME FedWatch tool, the probability of a 25‑basis‑point rate hike by the end of the month fell to about 20% by the end of last week, down from roughly 70% at the start of the week.
U.S. economic data this week is relatively light, with the market mainly focused on the Fed’s minutes from the last rate‑setting meeting.

On Monday, the Institute for Supply Management (ISM) released its September services report, showing service‑sector activity slowing from August but still in expansion territory. Notably, the prices paid index accelerated in September, reaching its highest level since July 2022.

Lloyds Bank analyst said, “Data early this month have been relatively light. This week’s main focus will be the final services and composite PMI releases. Those numbers should provide more detail on the euro‑area economy and may further clarify the impact of rising energy prices. In the preliminary data released earlier, the effect of higher energy costs was not obvious.”
